subject: [hw] opus-venc -> V41: drain list_free after every encode (SEQ_HDR size is only there); FRAME_FINAL w/o frame; text in fakevenc/apply_patches.py
body: 1) Required: libvpud_vcodec answers the SEQ_HDR ENCODE with ENCODE_ACK (0xd005, all-zero fields) and leaves the header size in venc_vsi.list_free (r=0 w=1 n=1 bs_size 0x1d), sending no PUT_BUFFER. The kernel drains it itself in sync mode (mtk_enc_put_buf after venc_if_encode, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:2590/:1931). Call ven_put_buffer(e) right after ven_send() succeeded in n2ap_venc_encode, before the freed[] lookup. Without it seq-hdr bytes=0 and the frame wait returns the header entry (29 bytes). 2) Optional: allow frame_handle 0 when bs_mode is FRAME_FINAL (EOS flush), reject only FRAME without a frame. 3) If your wait_done lands, my n2ap_venc_wait_output in apply_patches.py is redundant; same semantics (poll freed[] for the bs cookie, then n2vc_dma_sync from_device).
